checks.evidence: R2 freezes SOURCE_SEMANTICS_INVALID/LIMIT, SCHEMA_INVALID, association/conflict/provenance/inventory/registration/locator/display/assessment/compile codes with exit values, instance_pointer requirement, full-object preflight, shape-before-map-before-content ordering, stable pointer/keyword ordering and phase precedence.

R2 defines a closed source-ledger projection with exact root/row fields, enums, null-versus-absent, timestamp/date rules, path/URL grammar, synthetic pairing, target row identity/primary binding, exact historical bytes, no wall clock and no delegation to the full upstream validator.

Registration requires generic capture receipt=null/head=null/claimed_inputs=[], separate ingest receipt, first raw-path claim, one matching read plus source-ledger write, canonical reachable receipt chain, replay and ledger binding; relabeling a raw create is refused.

Same-key/same-raw reuse now requires exact observation, registration proof and extraction reference; metadata changes return SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VARIANT exit 75; old references are immutable and no duplicate association is manufactured.
Accepted version form is exactly {kind: unknown|declared, label}; conflict keys and unknown semantics use kind consistently.
R2 forbids canonical alias ownership collisions across primary/alias owners and requires optional arxiv_id/doi normalization to the primary or stated canonical alias without changing legacy IDs.

No-v2 input requires empty source maps and delegates exact v1 compile; mixed compile validates complete source material, preserves unchanged legacy bytes for unchanged related sets, renders explicit version/selection/evidence/assessment state, rejects graph/owner/path/taxonomy conflicts and uses deterministic sorted output.

Durable JCS bytes have no terminal LF; raw/extraction hashes and source identity are exact; Markdown charspan is decoded Unicode character count with no normalization/newline rewrite, exact excerpt hash, anchor containment and null cross-page handling.

R2 binds v1->v2 migration to exact claim text and complete historic v1 event objects/IDs/links/profile, requires first v2 event to link actual v1 terminal event, forbids drop/regenerate/relabel, and requires immutable event-byte prefix comparison by the retained publisher.

R2 fixes the 来源版本 section, selected/unselected lines, sorted association bullets, evidence bullet identity, span/excerpt display, exact provisional wording, frontmatter append order and complete expected-byte fixtures.
Existing v1 APIs/errors remain unchanged; new wrappers dispatch only seven new schemas, preserve delegated v1 errors, and keep v1 locators/fingerprints/compiler bytes stable.

residuals.requirement: Builder must route malformed raw UTF-8/size/path and source-map content failures through SOURCE_INVENTORY_INVALID or the explicitly scoped lower-level code, with stable pointers, rather than leaking UnicodeError/KeyError.

Builder must add the complete expected v2 byte fixture and mixed legacy/concept/code bytes exactly as required by R2; the contract fixes the skeleton and field order, while the fixture proves every blank line, escaping and link spelling.
Builder tests must exercise actual capture->ingest historical fixtures, not fabricate an earlier capture receipt, and must verify v1 result bytes plus the immutable v2 migration prefix.

scope: Bounded read-only freeze review of SOURCE-SEMANTICS-R2 against accepted L1 semantics and recovered R1 evidence. No source, schema, Git, Vault, network or external runtime changes.
